Use case: compositing. Create ONE 1920x1080 landscape concept paint-over for Human Last Rampart, scene 1 of 3: NIGHT BATTLE / COURTYARD BEACON. Output a single image no labels no UI.
References: image1 actual game night battle, authoritative shallow elevated game camera, horizontal rectangular crenellated grey wall, squat chunky pixel soldiers and dark navy shadows; image2 actual prep courtyard authoritative geography: left damaged wall/scaffold, arched barracks at left-center, middle wooden-roof workshop, right green awning shop, far-right broad stone stair leading FROM wall walkway DOWN into courtyard. Preserve these relationships and ochre stone paving, not a new fantasy castle. image3 existing beacon tower design: low broad octagonal stepped stone base, squat grey masonry column with amber slit windows, bronze fire bowl and stone crown prongs. Enlarge ONLY its base to a functional open-arched machinery chamber for burly workers, retain recognizable top silhouette. image4 Lumen variant A identity: brown hair, cream short cape, navy/gold cadet uniform, small belt lantern, big boots. image5 authoritative chunky in-game proportions (second figure): large head one third of body, short sturdy limbs, clear blue eyes white highlights AND visible small mouth.
Compose a continuous playable courtyard, shallow elevated frontal game camera, no isometric birdseye, no cinematic horizon or sky. Rear north wall horizontal across upper third, troops small in two ranks on walkway facing north. Stairs at right descend into courtyard; Lumen halfway down, three-quarter front view, one boot on lower step, his visible mouth and eyes clearly drawn. Central courtyard beacon sits at x~1000 y~720, total tower height ~350px, hero ~135px tall with ~45px head; preserve game scale, not giant protagonist. A few burly middle-aged workers visible through base opening. Clear walkable connection from stair foot to tower. Warm near-white directional light bursts FROM BEHIND tower crown, stone prongs sharply silhouetted; SINGLE broad golden searchlight cone goes away from viewer toward NORTH upper center beyond rear wall. Bright core restricted behind crown, no all-over bloom, no fog veil. Dark charcoal/navy night, localized warm torches with real falloff and cast shadows. Crisp chunky outlined pixel figures, 3 shades per material; textured HD-2D 3D-like stone environment, consistent crisp detail, restrained edge-only depth blur. Avoid smooth plastic, neon teal/purple, faceless heads, glowy outlines, disconnected steps, clutter, symmetrical generic fantasy castle. This is a reference concept, no code or sprite sheet.

Use case: compositing. Create ONE 1920x1080 landscape reference concept paint-over, Human Last Rampart scene 2: CLOSE VIEW INSIDE THE COURTYARD BEACON BASE AT NIGHT. Image1 authoritative courtyard geography and masonry; image2 authoritative squat octagonal beacon top and stone plinth design, expand base only as needed to fit a functional chamber, not a tall lighthouse; image3 Lumen variant A identity; image4 authoritative short sturdy chunky game sprite proportions, SECOND figure. NOT a photoreal illustration.
A close three-quarter frontal view into an OPEN FRONT ARCH of the broad octagonal stone beacon base. Front wall is cut away explicitly for concept visibility, the mechanism is INSIDE the tower. Three burly middle-aged laborers with thick forearms, beards or moustaches, rolled cream sleeves, brown aprons, stocky bodies, large pixel heads and heavy boots push horizontal wooden capstan bars at waist height. A sturdy vertical iron axle rises from the central capstan drum to a visible large cog and turntable beneath the beacon crown; all bars meet the same hub, every worker has two hands planted on ONE bar and boots braced on stone floor, believable grips and workload. Behind, warm amber slit windows, hard localized amber reflections, strong real shadows. The upper part of frame shows squat stone crown prongs and bronze firebowl, powerful warm-white light emitting from BEHIND the crown and a single directed cone sweeping across upper background toward north, two subtle curved movement streaks near turntable imply slow rotation; no arrows or labels.
Lumen stands OUTSIDE opening at left, entirely separate from bars, raises one commanding open hand toward workers; brown tousled hair, blue irises with white highlights, clearly visible small OPEN MOUTH shouting an order, cream short cape, navy cadet uniform with narrow brass trim, belt lantern, short sturdy legs, large brown boots. Head ~one third body height, thick dark outlines, about 3 tones per material. Hero and workers same human scale; workers broader not twice taller. Hero body approx 230px tall in this close shot with head~75px, scene environment dominates. Far right background contains actual game's stone staircase descending from crenellated wall; workshop and green awning barely visible out of focus at edges, ochre square paving matches courtyard. Crisp HD-2D pixel clusters, dark navy night and warm amber points, no grey veil, no neon teal/purple, no smooth painterly faces, no glossy plastic, no decorative clutter, no words, no UI, no borders. This is a static concept reference; motion only implied.

Use case: lighting-weather and precise-object-edit. Create ONE 1920x1080 landscape concept paint-over, Human Last Rampart scene3 DAY PREPARATION. Image1 is the approved-for-continuity NIGHT CONCEPT of this exact courtyard: keep its camera, courtyard layout, same position/size/shape of central octagonal beacon with broad open machinery base, rear barracks arch at left, workshop at center, green-awning shop at right, far right stair descending into courtyard, left damaged wall and scaffold, ochre square paving and red banners. Image2 actual game prep courtyard authoritative structure/colors; image3 Lumen variant A identity; image4 authoritative in-game chunky human proportions.
Change image1 to clear ordinary daylight. Upper-left sun casts strong coherent shadows lower-right. Desaturate gold to natural tan stone, charcoal cool shadows, restrained moss. No golden atmospheric haze or sunrise. Beacon is OFF: no beam, no burst, no lit bowl. 3 burly middle-aged workers repair it: one on a properly supported wooden scaffold beside crown using a hammer on a stone prong; one on scaffold's lower landing fitting bronze ring, one on the ground carrying a modest replacement stone toward base. Workers stocky short large-head pixel people with aprons rolled sleeves heavy boots, boots touching actual supports. Scaffolding wraps left half of central beacon with sensible vertical posts, braced horizontal decks, diagonal supports and a ladder. Keep beacon silhouette clearly visible. Open base shows idle capstan, horizontal bars and central vertical shaft, no magic portal. A restrained ground workbench with hammer and masonry blocks beside base, spare beams in a tidy stack. Lumen near tower right giving quiet repair directions, brown hair cream cape navy-gold cadet uniform belt lantern short sturdy proportions head one-third body, blue eyes highlights visible small mouth. Preserve soldier silhouettes on far wall with fewer people, not a parade; maintain access from stairs to tower and all shops. Clear same-location continuity with night reference, no new palace or taller fantasy cathedral. HD-2D crisp dark outline pixel sprites, approx3 tone materials, chunky pixels, textured stone, real sunlight/shadows. No UI no words no borders, no bloom no fog veil no neon colors no plastic faces. Static illustration only.
